pages.text: Every parrot you meet leaves a $(l)coloured feather$(). Weave seven of them onto a string and you get a $(l)Garland$(): bunting to hang across your workshop.$(br2)The feathers you choose decide its colours, so seven brown feathers and a mix of red and blue make very different garlands.
First, nails. They drive into any block face, floor, wall or ceiling.

pages.title: Hanging one
pages.text: Place two nails, then with a garland in hand:$(br)$(li)Right-click the $(l)first nail$() to tie it on$(li)Right-click the $(l)second nail$() to string it across$(br2)While it's tied, the garland trails from your hand so you can see where it will fall. Right-click the same nail again to let go.$(br2)Nails can be up to $(l)12 blocks$() apart.

pages.title: Stringing them together
pages.text: A nail holds up to $(l)four$() garlands, so you can run one span into the next and carry bunting right along a wall, or fan several out from a single point.$(br2)The cord sags under its own weight, and hangs deeper the longer the span.$(br2)To take one down, break either nail: the garland drops back to you.
